subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Formal forgiveness of a person’s sins
solution:
The correct answer is "**Absolution**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To different people, ***formal forgiveness*** might signify many things.
 
• Yet generally, it entails making a conscious choice to*** let go*** of bitterness and rage.
 
• ***Forgiveness*** is the act of letting go of negative emotions and ideas towards the person who injured you in favor of happy emotions and thoughts.
 
• The theological term "***absolution***" refers to the ***forgiveness*** given by trained Christian priests and embraced by Christian penitents. (अपराध, दायित्व या दंड से औपचारिक रिहाई) 
 
• Therefore, ***absolution*** is the correct substitution for formal forgiveness of a person’s sins. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Ablutions*** mean the act of cleansing oneself. (स्वयं को शुद्ध करने की क्रिया)
 
• ***Absolutism*** means the adoption of unbreakable beliefs in theology, philosophy, or politics. (निरंकुश राज्य का सिद्धान्त)
 
• ***Forgiveness*** means a conscious choice to let go of bitterness and rage. (माफी)
